quote: 城東有窣堵波，無憂王之所建也，即過去四佛說法之處…伐蘇蜜呾羅
note: Aśokan stūpa where the four past Buddhas preached; Vasumitra composed the Prakaraṇapāda (眾事分阿毘達磨論, a Sarvāstivāda abhidharma text) here

quote: 有故伽藍，庭宇荒涼，僧徒寡少，然皆遵習小乘法教
note: Dharmatrāta composed the Saṃyuktābhidharmahṛdaya (雜阿毘達磨論) here

quote: 伽藍側有窣堵波，高數百尺，無憂王之所建也…千生捨眼
note: jātaka of the thousand gifts of eyes

quote: 白衣外道本師悟所求理初說法處…傍建天祠…唯留少髮，加之露形，或有所服，白色為異
note: coded as in 03.04.03 (same passage): 白衣外道 with naked and white-clad members = Digambara and Śvetāmbara Jains (Mizutani); monks called bhikṣu and śrāmaṇera; their teacher's image resembles the Buddha's

quote: 其南百四五十步有石窣堵波，摩訶薩埵愍餓獸之無力也
note: Mahāsattva jātaka (blood fed to the tigress)

quote: 國大都城周二十餘里
note: capital of Ṭakka; the country description (04.01) has 少信佛法，多事天神。伽藍十所，天祠數百

quote: 有窣堵波，高二百餘尺，無憂王之所建也，是過去四佛說法之處
note: Aśokan stūpa where the four past Buddhas preached

quote: 至石窣堵波，高二百餘尺，無憂王之所建也…窣堵波中有多舍利
note: Aśokan stone stūpa where the Buddha halted on his northern tour; relics (Indian record)

quote: 至大涸池，傍有窣堵波…時有彌猴，持蜜奉佛
note: dry tank with the stūpa of the monkey's honey offering

quote: 有窣堵波，高二百餘尺，無憂王之所建也…中有如來舍利一斗
note: Aśokan stūpa with a dou of relics

quote: 至小伽藍，僧徒五十餘人…本習大乘…退業而學小乘
note: school of the monastery not stated; Guṇaprabha turned from Mahāyāna to Hīnayāna after reading the Vibhāṣā; legend of his visit to Maitreya in Tuṣita

quote: 有大伽藍，僧徒二百餘人，並學小乘法教，是眾賢論師壽終之處
note: Saṅghabhadra, Sarvāstivāda Vibhāṣā master (說一切有部毘婆沙論), died here; his Nyāyānusāra (順正理論) against Vasubandhu's Kośa

quote: 於伽藍西北二百餘步菴沒羅林中，起窣堵波，今猶現在
note: stūpa over Saṅghabhadra's bones

quote: 毘末羅蜜多羅（唐言無垢友）論師之遺身…於說一切有部而出家焉
note: Vimalamitra, ordained in the Sarvāstivāda, died after vowing to destroy the Mahāyāna; personal affiliation, not the site's

quote: 城外龍池側有窣堵波，無憂王之所建也…其側有四小窣堵波
note: Aśokan stūpa by the nāga tank; four small stūpas of the past Buddhas

quote: 伽藍東南重閣上有故塼室，世親菩薩嘗住此中作《唯識論》破斥小乘，難諸外道
note: Vasubandhu's room in Ghoṣila's monastery; composed a Vijñaptimātratā treatise refuting the Hīnayāna and the 外道

quote: 毒龍石窟。昔者如來伏此毒龍，於中留影…其側有窣堵波，無憂王之所建也…髮、爪窣堵波
note: cave of the Buddha's shadow (no longer seen), Aśokan stūpa, hair-and-nail stūpa; healing cult

quote: 故宮城內有故基，勝軍王殿餘趾也
note: Prasenajit's palace foundations

quote: 有一故基，上建小窣堵波，昔勝軍王為如來所建大法堂也
note: site of Prasenajit's hall of the Law

quote: 故基上有窣堵波，是佛姨母鉢邏闍鉢底…苾芻尼精舍
note: site of Mahāprajāpatī's nunnery (ruined, marked by a stūpa)

quote: 次東窣堵波，是蘇達多
note: Sudatta's house

quote: 有大窣堵波，是鴦窶利摩羅…捨邪之處
note: Aṅgulimāla's conversion; his former teacher's doctrine (kill the Buddha and one's mother to be reborn in Brahmā's heaven) is part of the legend, not a contemporary cult

quote: 宮城之側有一伽藍，僧徒三千餘人，習學小乘正量部教
note: the only monastery with monks reported at Kapilavastu; 正量部 = Sāṃmitīya

quote: 門外有自在天祠，祠中石天像
note: coded as in 06.02.08 (same passage): 自在天 = Īśvara (Śiva); the stone god rose to greet the infant prince

quote: 城南門外路左，有窣堵波，是太子與諸釋角藝，射鐵鼓
note: archery contest

quote: 淨飯王正殿也。上建精舍，中作王像…中作夫人之像…中作菩薩降神之像
note: shrines with images of Śuddhodana, Māyā and the descent into the womb on the palace foundations

quote: 有窣堵波，阿私多仙相太子處
note: Asita's prediction

quote: 城南門有窣堵波，是太子與諸釋角力擲象之處…土俗相傳為象墮阬也
note: stūpa of the elephant throw; the elephant pit (Hastigarta)

quote: 其側又有精舍，太子妃寢宮也，中作耶輸陀羅，并有羅怙羅像
note: shrine with images of Yaśodharā and Rāhula

quote: 宮側精舍作受業之像，太子學堂故基也
note: shrine with an image of the prince at study

quote: 城東南隅有一精舍，中作太子乘白馬凌虛之像，是踰城處也
note: shrine with an image of the prince leaving on his white horse

quote: 城四門外各有精舍，中作老、病、死人、沙門之像
note: shrines of the four sights

quote: 大城西北，有數百千窣堵波，釋種誅死處也
note: massacre of the Śākyas by Virūḍhaka

quote: 有窣堵波，是如來修菩薩行時，為鹿救生之處
note: deer jātaka

quote: 有窣堵波，是蘇跋陀羅…入寂滅之處
note: Subhadra, a brahmin ascetic (梵志) converted as the last disciple; non-Buddhist only within the legend

quote: 有窣堵波，無憂王所建也，是八王分舍利處。前建石柱，刻記其事
note: division of the relics; inscribed pillar

quote: 大城西北伽藍中窣堵波，無憂王之所建也…有如來舍利一斗…慈氏菩薩像
note: monastery with an Aśokan stūpa, seats of three past Buddhas and a Maitreya image; monks not stated in this passage

quote: 石柱南有池，是群獼猴為佛穿也
note: tank dug by the monkeys

quote: 池西不遠有窣堵波…池南不遠有窣堵波，是諸獼猴奉佛蜜處；池西北隅猶有獼猴形像
note: stūpas of the monkey's honey; a monkey figure

quote: 是無憂王作地獄處…伽藍、天祠及窣堵波，餘址數百，存者二三
note: Aśoka's hell; the passage reports Pāṭaliputra's monasteries, deva temples and stūpas in ruins (hundreds, two or three standing)

quote: 精舍中有大石，如來所履，雙迹猶存…近者設賞迦王毀壞佛法
note: vihāra with the Buddha's footprints; Śaśāṅka tried to destroy them

quote: 故宮北有大石室…是無憂王為出家弟役使神鬼之所建也
note: stone house built by spirits for Aśoka's brother Mahendra, an arhat

quote: 故宮西南有小石山，周巖谷間，數十石室，無憂王為近護等諸阿羅漢
note: rock-cut cells for Upagupta and other arhats; old terrace

quote: 隣國遠人謂之聖水，若有飲濯，罪垢消滅
note: a popular bathing/drinking cult (sins washed away); no tradition named

quote: 山西南有五窣堵波…尚餘五斗舍利，故別崇建五窣堵波
note: five stūpas (ruined, rebuilt small); rival legend of King Nanda's treasure

quote: 菩提樹北有佛經行之處…後人於此壘甎為基
note: the Buddha's promenade; brick base used for life-span divination

quote: 有大池…婆羅門兄弟承大自在天命之所鑿也
note: tank dug by the brahmin brothers at Maheśvara's command (cf. 08.06.04)

quote: 次南一池…天帝釋為佛化成池
note: Indra's tank and the robe-drying stone

quote: 有窣堵波，如來度優樓頻螺迦葉波三兄弟及千門人處…捨祭火具
note: conversion of the fire-worshipping Kāśyapa brothers (legend only)

quote: 其側窣堵波，二長者獻麨蜜處…長者獻麨側有窣堵波，四天奉鉢處
note: offerings of the two merchants and of the four heavenly kings (legend only)

quote: 有窣堵波，如來為母說法處也…其側涸池岸有窣堵波
note: sermon to Māyā; miracles by the dry pool (legend only)

quote: 是如來伏迦葉波所事火龍處…其側窣堵波，五百獨覺同入涅槃處也
note: the Kāśyapas' fire-nāga; 500 pratyekabuddhas (legend only)

quote: 目支隣陀龍池南窣堵波，迦葉波救如來溺水處也
note: the flood miracle (legend only)

quote: 中路有二小窣堵波，一謂下乘…一謂退凡
note: Bimbisāra's road

quote: 城南門外，道左有窣堵波，如來於此說法及度羅怙羅
note: sermon and ordination of Rāhula

quote: 此伽藍南菴沒羅林中有池，其龍名那爛陀
note: the nāga Nālanda, origin of the monastery's name

quote: 其南則有觀自在菩薩立像
note: Avalokiteśvara image (Mahāyāna cult object)

quote: 觀自在菩薩像南窣堵波中，有如來三月之間剃剪髮、爪
note: hair-and-nail stūpa; healing cult

quote: 有大精舍，高三百餘尺，婆羅阿迭多王之所建也
note: Bālāditya's great vihāra, modelled on the Mahābodhi

quote: 有銅立佛像，高八十餘尺，重閣六層
note: Pūrṇavarman's copper Buddha

quote: 東峯上有伽藍…昔此伽藍習翫小乘…大乘者，正理也，宜改先執
note: formerly Hīnayāna (allowing the three pure kinds of meat), converted to Mahāyāna after the goose's self-sacrifice (legend)

quote: 有窣堵波，頻毘娑羅王迎見佛處
note: Bimbisāra's welcome (legend only)

quote: 有窣堵波，是尊者舍利子門人入涅槃處
note: Śāriputra's disciples; three koṭis of arhats under Kāśyapa Buddha

quote: 渡大河，至迦摩縷波國
note: river on the route; nothing on religion

quote: 有大伽藍，重閣層臺…伽藍前有石窣堵波，高數百尺
note: monastery and stone stūpa built by the arhat Acala (阿折羅); monks and school not stated

quote: 到一寺宿，寺名護瑟迦羅
note: Life: Xuanzang's first night in Kashmir; the monks dream of his coming

quote: 至都，止闍耶因陀羅寺
note: Life: Xuanzang's lodging in the capital

quote: 宿於外道寺。寺在城西門外
note: Life: Xuanzang lodged in a non-Buddhist temple (外道寺) outside the west gate of Jayapura

quote: 從此出那羅僧訶城
note: Life: route mention only

quote: 其城有數千戶，信佛者蓋少，宗事外道者極多
note: Life: no monasteries mentioned; 300 converted after Xuanzang's appeal; the 700-year-old brahmin was a disciple of Nāgārjuna, versed in the Madhyamaka and Śata treatises and the Vedas

quote: 見牛入一石孔…漸變為石，猶有人狀
note: Life: legend of the cowherd turned to stone, set before the Buddha's time; no tradition named
